content:
Access control, role-based access control (RBAC) enforced at all layers. AES-256 encryption for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit. Session timeout after 15 minutes of inactivity. Session timeout policy enforcement.
Data protection requires PII detection and masking, regular data retention policy enforcement. Regular security audits and penetration testing for compliance and risk management.
In addition to RBAC and AES-256 encryption, our security protocols include TLS 1.3 for data in transit, managed identities for Azure resources, network security groups for traffic control, and Docker Compose for local development using GitHub Actions.
We adhere to SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance standards for EU data subjects and HIPAA ready healthcare workloads with regular third-party security assessments.
Our deployment procedures include automated alerting via Azure Monitor for detection, containment in a managed identity system at Azure resources for network isolation and access revocation, and regular recovery from restored backups.

The Enterprise Knowledge Base (EKB) is an organization specializing in AI-powered enterprises. This company builds scalable RAG systems, knowledge management platforms, and intelligent automation tools. The goal is to build a scalable, efficient platform for businesses that want to automate tasks with AI technologies. It's about building systems that recognize patterns and make predictions based on those patterns, improving capabilities over time by enabling machines to learn from data without human input. The EKB builds knowledge management platforms and intelligently automates business processes.
The key capabilities of the EKB include scalable RAG systems, knowledge management platforms, intelligent automation tools, and a variety of other services aimed at enhancing operations and efficiency in businesses that operate with AI technologies.
It's also about building an organization that specializes in AI-powered enterprises. This is different from traditional IT companies that build complex IT infrastructure to support business operations. It's about providing solutions that help businesses stay up-to-date with the latest technology advancements, optimize resources and processes for maximum productivity and performance.
The EKB builds knowledge management platforms to help organizations manage their information flows and access to data effectively. It also offers intelligent automation tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency across all levels of the business operations.
